'''Byblos Medical Tower''' was one of immense towers that was located in [[Byblos City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]]. Some forms of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] were able to be legally obtained there, but it was heavily regulated.<ref name="Platt's Starport Guide">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>
